lines.en: label karindate1:
Maybe I’ll see what Karin is up to?
lines.zh: 要不我去看看 Karin 在干什么？

lines.en: "I know that she spends virtually all of her time doing stuff for her
lines.zh: “我知道她几乎所有时间都花在给她那些

lines.en: different teams or clubs or whatever, but now that I’m her “coach,” maybe I can find my way in?"
lines.zh: 不同的队伍、社团之类的忙活上了，不过既然我现在是她的“教练”，说不定我能找到门路走进去？”

lines.en: To her life, I mean. Not her.
lines.zh: 走进她的生活，我是说。不是走进她。

lines.en: Well, yes her. But not right now.
lines.zh: 好吧，也包括她。但不是现在。

lines.en: Unless she wants it.
lines.zh: 除非她愿意。

lines.en: Whatever. You know what I mean.
lines.zh: 算了。你懂我的意思。

lines.en: I select Karin’s name in my phone and wait for her to pick up.
lines.zh: 我在手机里点开 Karin 的名字，等着她接。

lines.en: Given how embarrassed she was to even give me her number, I imagine she’ll let it ring a few times before-
lines.zh: 想到她当初连把号码给我都那么难为情，我以为她至少会让电话响几声才——

lines.en: : Hello?
: Oh, hey.
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿。

lines.en: : I wasn’t expecting you to pick up right away.
lines.zh: : 我没想到你会马上接。

lines.en: : Oh! Uhh...hahah, yeah. I just kind of had my phone out and, you know...answered it. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦！呃……哈哈，是啊。我刚好把手机拿在手里，然后就……接了。对。

lines.en: : ...Right.
: Well, anyway, what are you up to right now?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你现在在忙什么？

lines.en: : Me? I was about to go to the park. Why?
lines.zh: : 我？我正打算去公园。怎么了？

lines.en: "Knowing that Karin would probably drop her phone if I asked her to “hang out” right now, I
lines.zh: “我知道，要是这会儿开口约 Karin“一起出去玩”，她大概会吓得把手机摔了，所以我

lines.en: decide to get creative and start making use of my newly appointed position."
lines.zh: 决定换个花样，开始好好利用我这个刚上任的新身份。”

lines.en: : Do you mind if I tag along?
lines.zh: : 我跟着一起去，你介意吗？

lines.en: : Huh? Why?
lines.zh: : 啊？为什么？

lines.en: : You’re going there to jog or run or something like that, right? That sounds like a thing you would do.
lines.zh: : 你是去那儿慢跑还是跑步什么的，对吧？听起来像是你会做的事。

lines.en: : Uh-huh...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……

lines.en: : Well, I’d like to sort of see you in action if I’m going to be in charge of you from now on.
lines.zh: : 嗯，既然从现在起由我来负责你，我想看看你实际的表现。

lines.en: : In action?! Like, alone?? Can’t you just come watch us play at the field or-
lines.zh: : 实际表现？！就、就我们两个人？？你不能来球场看我们打球吗，或者——

lines.en: : One on one sessions are good for establishing relationships with your team.
lines.zh: : 一对一的交流，有助于跟队员建立关系。

lines.en: : And seeing as I already know Miku pretty well, you’re second in line.
lines.zh: : 鉴于我已经跟 Miku 挺熟了，你就排在第二位。

lines.en: if kirindate1 == True:
: Second? But, didn’t you and Kirin hang out the other day?
lines.zh: : 第二？可你前两天不是和 Kirin 一起出去了吗？

lines.en: ...Did Kirin really tell her about that?
lines.zh: ……Kirin 还真跟她说了那件事？

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: : We did. But that wasn’t related to the team. This is.
lines.zh: : 是的。不过那次跟队伍无关。这次有关。

lines.en: : Well...um...it does feel a little weird...but I guess I can see where you’re coming from.
lines.zh: : 嗯……呃……是有点奇怪……不过我想我明白你的意思。

lines.en: : Do you want to just meet me there? Do you need me to bring anything for you? Water, maybe?
lines.zh: : 你要不要直接在那儿跟我碰面？需要我给你带点什么吗？水什么的？

lines.en: : I’ll be fine. Are you going to the park near the[school] or a different one?
lines.zh: : 我不用。你是去[school]附近那个公园，还是别的地方？

lines.en: : The[school] one. I’ll leave now if you’re going to head over there.
lines.zh: : [school] 那个。你要过去的话，我现在就出发。

lines.en: : Sounds good. I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 好。待会儿见。

lines.en: : Uh-huh! See you soon!
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！待会儿见！

lines.en: else:
: Really? I mean, I guess that’s reasonable since I’m co-captain but...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我的意思是，我是副队长，这么说也合理啦，不过……

lines.en: : I don’t know. Is it weird if I’m kind of...maybe a little happy to hear that? Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。听到这个……我有点……可能有点开心，会不会很奇怪？哈哈哈……

lines.en: : It’s not weird at all. I’m excited to get to learn more about you.
lines.zh: : 一点都不奇怪。我也很期待能多了解你一些。

lines.en: : Ah-! Yeah! I’m excited to learn more about me too! Ah, wait! I meant you! I already, um, know about...me...And-
lines.zh: : 啊——！对！我也很期待多了解我自己！啊，等等！我是说了解你！我已经，呃，很了解……我自己了……然后——

lines.en: : Actually, is it okay if I just hang up now and meet you at the park?
lines.zh: : 其实，我现在挂电话、直接去公园跟你会合，可以吗？

lines.en: : I’m going to the one by the[school] and I’ll start heading over now if you’re ready.
lines.zh: : 我去[school]旁边那个，你要是准备好了，我现在就出发。

lines.en: : Sure thing. I’ll see you soon, then.
lines.zh: : 没问题。那待会儿见。

lines.en: : Uh-huh! See you soon!
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！待会儿见！

lines.en: "I hang up the phone and slide it back into my pocket, wondering if Karin is
lines.zh: “我挂了电话，把手机滑回口袋，心里琢磨着 Karin

lines.en: going to make me jog as well today."
lines.zh: 今天会不会也拉着我一起跑。”

lines.en: I really hope not.
lines.zh: 我真的希望不会。

lines.en: scene black
scene karinjogs1
I arrive at the park near[school] and find Karin standing near the fountain waiting for me.
lines.zh: 我到了[school]附近的公园，看见 Karin 站在喷泉边等我。

lines.en: "The sun peers through the trees as it begins to set and finds its way onto her well-toned, yet still
lines.zh: “夕阳透过树梢洒落下来，落在她那线条紧实、却依然

lines.en: seemingly delicate body."
lines.zh: 显得纤细的身体上。”

lines.en: : G-Good evening!
lines.zh: : 晚、晚上好！

lines.en: : Thanks for coming out to watch over me today...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你今天特意过来看着我……

lines.en: scene karinjogs2
: Oh, wait! I meant watch me! Not watch over me! I can take care of myself!
lines.zh: : 哦，等等！我是说看我！不是看着我！我自己能照顾好自己！

lines.en: : I know what you meant, don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我知道你想说什么，别担心。

lines.en: : In a sense, I might even need you to watch over me today.
lines.zh: : 从某种角度说，今天说不定还得请你多照看我一点。

lines.en: scene karinjogs3
: Huh? What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 啊？你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: : I’m not sure what Miku told you about me, but I don’t know much about sports.
lines.zh: : 我不知道 Miku 跟你说过我什么，不过我对体育了解不多。

lines.en: : I actually think it’s a little strange that she wanted someone like me to be your coach despite that.
lines.zh: : 说实话，尽管这样她还想要我这样的人来当你们的教练，我觉得挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : It seems like the two of you take this pretty seriously, so I’ll try not to get in the way too much.
lines.zh: : 看来你们俩对这事挺认真的，所以我会尽量不碍事。

lines.en: scene karinjogs4
: You don’t have to worry about that...Miku and I are already grateful
lines.zh: : 这个你不用担心……Miku 和我都很感激你

lines.en: that you’re going out of your way for us."
lines.zh: 愿意为我们费这份心。”

lines.en: Well, it’s not like I {i}chose{/i} to go out of my way. I was dragged into this by force.
lines.zh: 嗯，我可不是{i}自愿{/i}费这份心的。我是被硬拽进来的。

lines.en: : It’s okay if you don’t know much about sports. I...wouldn’t really mind teaching you.
lines.zh: : 你对体育不了解也没关系。我……其实挺愿意教你的。

lines.en: scene karinjogs5
: We just...kind of need a teacher to be present in order to keep playing.
lines.zh: : 我们只是……需要有个老师在场，才能继续活动下去。

lines.en: : That’s...one of the several reasons I was surprised to hear you actually trying to get involved today...
lines.zh: : 这也是……今天听说你真的想参与进来，我会那么惊讶的几个原因之一……

lines.en: : Speaking of involvement, would you mind telling me a little about what you do here?
lines.zh: : 说到参与，你介意跟我讲讲你平时在这儿都做些什么吗？

lines.en: scene karinjogs3
: Nothing special, really. I just come here a couple times a week to run laps around the park.
lines.zh: : 其实没什么特别的。我一周来这儿两三次，绕着公园跑几圈。

lines.en: : It’s normally pretty quiet here on weekends since no one stops by on the way home from[school].
lines.zh: : 周末这儿通常挺安静的，因为没人会在从[school]回家的路上顺道过来。

lines.en: scene karinjogs5
: On weekdays, though, I normally just wind up training with Miku or some of the
lines.zh: : 不过工作日的时候，我一般就是跟 Miku 或者其他几个

lines.en: other girls. It’s not often that I’m alone. So this is a little weird for me."
lines.zh: 女孩一起训练。我很少一个人待着。所以现在这样我有点不习惯。”

lines.en: : Well you’re already doing better than you normally do, so I’m proud of you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你已经比平时表现得好了，我为你骄傲。

lines.en: scene karinjogs6
: Well, it’s not like I have a choice anymore, is it? You’re my coach.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我现在也没得选了，不是吗？你是我教练。

lines.en: : If I can’t get over a hurdle as small as just looking you in the eyes, there’s no way I’ll be able to climb over anything else.
lines.zh: : 要是连直视你眼睛这么小的坎都过不去，那别的什么坎我都不可能翻得过去。

lines.en: : Just...try not to come too close too quickly or something because I probably won’t be able to prevent myself from having some weird reaction.
lines.zh: : 只是……尽量别太快靠太近什么的，因为我大概拦不住自己会做出什么奇怪的反应。

lines.en: : Noted. We should be practicing social distancing anyway in case some weird disease ever starts going around.
lines.zh: : 记住了。再说我们本来也应该保持社交距离，万一哪天真有什么怪病传开呢。

lines.en: scene karinjogs7
: Hahah...Yeah, I guess we probably should...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……是啊，大概是该这样……

lines.en: Karin’s smile somehow manages to light up the world even in the midst of the sunset.
lines.zh: Karin 的笑容，总能在夕阳之中把整个世界照亮。

lines.en: "She’s a mix of a lot of different great qualities, so I’m glad to see that she’s not
lines.zh: “她身上糅合了许多不同的优点，所以我很高兴看到她并不像

lines.en: as...inherently weird as a lot of the other girls I’ve been dealing with lately."
lines.zh: 我最近打交道的其他女孩那样……天生就那么古怪。”

lines.en: : So...are you ready to start?
lines.zh: : 那么……准备好开始了吗？

lines.en: scene karinjogs8
: Yeah. I just need to run, right? Are you going to run with me?
lines.zh: : 嗯。我只管跑就行了，对吧？你要跟我一起跑吗？

lines.en: : You’re not really dressed for the task, so maybe you can just keep times for me instead?
lines.zh: : 你这身衣服不太适合跑步，要不你就帮我计时好了？

lines.en: : I can’t imagine it’ll be very fun, but at least you won’t have to get all sweaty that way.
lines.zh: : 我想这不会多有趣，不过至少那样你就不用弄得一身汗了。

lines.en: : That sounds good to me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得可以。

lines.en: I pull my phone out of my pocket and open up the stopwatch app.
lines.zh: 我从口袋里掏出手机，打开秒表应用。

lines.en: : Just hit the “lap” button every time I pass you, okay? That’s how I normally time myself. Just...with a tree instead of a teacher.
lines.zh: : 每次我经过你身边，你就按一下“计圈”键，好吗？我平时就是这么给自己计时的。只不过……平时是棵树，不是老师。

lines.en: : You don’t need to tell me my individual times. Just let me know how much faster or slower I am on each pass.
lines.zh: : 你不用告诉我每一圈的具体时间。只要告诉我每圈比之前快了多少或者慢了多少就行。

lines.en: : Endurance is important, so I need to make sure I’m able to keep up with myself more than anyone else.
lines.zh: : 耐力很重要，所以我得确认自己能跟得上自己，比对上任何人都重要。

lines.en: : Roger that. Official coach duties commencing now.
lines.zh: : 收到。正式教练职责，现在开始执行。

lines.en: I hit the start button on the stopwatch and immediately send Karin spiraling into panic.
lines.zh: 我按下秒表的开始键，Karin 立刻陷入了慌乱。

lines.en: scene karinjogs9
: Ah- Sensei, wait! You didn’t even count me down! Start over!
lines.zh: : 啊——老师，等等！你都没给我倒计时！重来一次！

lines.en: : No can do. Clock is already running. Go, Karin, go!
lines.zh: : 不行。表已经走了。去吧，Karin，去吧！

lines.en: scene karinjogs10
: Ahh! Okay! I’m going!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！好！我跑！

lines.en: scene karinjogs11
Karin quickly takes off into a sprint to make up for a few seconds worth of lost time.
lines.zh: Karin 立刻冲刺出去，想补回那几秒钟的损失。

lines.en: scene black
"I follow behind her until the two of us are safely out of the center of the park, watching
lines.zh: “我跟在她身后，直到我们俩离开公园中心地带，看着她

lines.en: as she gradually moves further and further away."
lines.zh: 一点一点地跑得越来越远。”

lines.en: The way she runs is a lot different than Miku.
lines.zh: 她跑步的样子跟 Miku 很不一样。

lines.en: "Every step that Karin takes seems carefully calculated, whereas Miku seems
lines.zh: “Karin 迈出的每一步都像是经过精心计算，而 Miku 则更像是

lines.en: more like a girl who just had one too many energy drinks and was told to run as fast as she can."
lines.zh: 一个灌了太多能量饮料、然后被叫去拼命跑的女孩。”

lines.en: scene karinjogs12
: How was...that one?
lines.zh: : 那圈……怎么样？

lines.en: : Thirty seconds under your last. You’re not starting to lose steam, are you?
lines.zh: : 比上一圈快了三十秒。你该不会开始没劲了吧？

lines.en: scene karinjogs13
: Of...course not! Watch me...closely this time!
lines.zh: : 当……当然没有！这次……你要看仔细了！

lines.en: scene karinjogs14
"Karin leaves me in the dust once again with a look of determination that could
lines.zh: “Karin 再一次把我甩在了身后，脸上的那股坚毅，

lines.en: rival some of the fiercest athletes."
lines.zh: 足以和最凶悍的运动员媲美。”

lines.en: "She's really fast despite her size. She’d probably even be able to
lines.zh: “以她的体格来说，她真的很快。要是她再矮上几英寸，

lines.en: beat Miku if she were several inches shorter and a lot less...busty."
lines.zh: 胸也没那么……丰满，说不定连 Miku 都跑得过她。”

lines.en: scene karinjogs15
: And...that one?
lines.zh: : 那……这圈呢？

lines.en: I look down at my phone again to realize that Karin has actually beaten the time of her first lap.
lines.zh: 我又低头看了看手机，才意识到 Karin 这一圈居然跑赢了她的第一圈。

lines.en: I was so caught up in admiration that I didn’t even realize she was giving it her all that time.
lines.zh: 我看得太入迷了，甚至没注意到她那一整圈都在拼命。

lines.en: : Fifteen seconds up.
lines.zh: : 快了十五秒。

lines.en: : From the last one or from the best one?
lines.zh: : 是比上一圈，还是比最好那一圈？

lines.en: : The best one. Did you want to call it now? Or do you have a few more in you?
lines.zh: : 最好的那圈。你想现在就收工？还是说你还有力气再来几圈？

lines.en: scene karinjogs16
: Heh...I could do this all day...
lines.zh: : 嘿……我能这样跑一整天……

lines.en: scene karinjogs14
"Once again, Karin takes off down the path, looking no slower than she did when she
lines.zh: “Karin 又一次沿着小路跑了出去，看上去和将近二十分钟前

lines.en: started almost twenty minutes ago."
lines.zh: 刚起步时一样快。”

lines.en: How the hell is she able to keep up that pace for so long without even looking phased?
lines.zh: 她到底是怎么做到用这个速度撑这么久，还一脸轻松的？

lines.en: If I were in her shoes, I’d be basically crawling right now.
lines.zh: 要是换了我，这会儿大概只能在地上爬了。

lines.en: scene karinjogs17
: Hah...
Karin comes to a stop several feet away from me after what I imagine is her last lap.
lines.zh: 我想那应该是她的最后一圈了，Karin 在离我几英尺远的地方停了下来。

lines.en: : Okay...Now I’m done.
lines.zh: : 好……跑完了。

lines.en: : I thought you were planning on going all day?
lines.zh: : 我还以为你打算跑一整天呢？

lines.en: : Nah...I was...starting to feel bad for you.
lines.zh: : 没啦……我是……开始觉得有点对不起你了。

lines.en: : You looked bored.
lines.zh: : 你看着挺无聊的。

lines.en: : I wasn’t bored at all. If anything, I was actually having a good time watching you.
lines.zh: : 我一点也不无聊。要说的话，看你跑我其实挺开心的。

lines.en: : You’re really impressive, Karin. I think I get why you’re so involved with athletics now.
lines.zh: : 你真的很了不起，Karin。我现在明白你为什么这么投入体育了。

lines.en: scene karinjogs18
: What?! No no no! I’m not that impressive. I just practice a lot.
lines.zh: : 什么？！不不不！我哪有那么了不起。我只是练得多而已。

lines.en: : Isn’t that the same thing? Most people don’t become great at anything without practicing.
lines.zh: : 这不是一回事吗？大多数人要是没有练习，都不可能把什么事做得很好。

lines.en: : Well, yeah, but like...I don’t know. Getting compliments from you feels weird. Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啦，可是……我也不知道。被你夸感觉怪怪的。哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Well you better get used to it, because I’m pretty sure this is going to be a regular occurrence from now on.
lines.zh: : 那你最好习惯一下，因为我敢肯定，从今往后这会是常有的事。

lines.en: scene karinjogs19
: You...want to do this again?
lines.zh: : 你……还想再来一次？

lines.en: : I thought you were just trying to get acquainted with everyone on the team?
lines.zh: : 我还以为你只是想跟队里的每个人都熟络一下？

lines.en: : Isn’t it unfair to spend more time with me when there are other girls who need more help?
lines.zh: : 还有别的女孩更需要帮助，你却花更多时间陪我，这样不太公平吧？

lines.en: Karin makes a good point. But something she doesn’t yet understand is that I’m not just doing this because I’m trying to be a good coach.
lines.zh: Karin 说得有道理。但她还不明白的是，我做这些不只是为了当个好教练。

lines.en: I want to get closer to {i}her{/i} specifically. If I didn’t, I wouldn’t have called her out here today.
lines.zh: 我是想专门跟{i}她{/i}走近一些。要不是这样，我今天就不会把她叫出来了。

lines.en: But that’s not something she needs to know yet.
lines.zh: 不过这件事她现在还不需要知道。

lines.en: Who even knows how someone as inexperienced and nervous around men would handle it if she were to hear something like that?
lines.zh: 谁也不知道，一个在男人面前这么没经验、又这么容易紧张的人，要是听到那种话会是什么反应。

lines.en: : I definitely want to do this again.
lines.zh: : 我当然还想再来。

lines.en: : Unless...you didn’t have fun hanging around me today?
lines.zh: : 除非……你今天跟我在一起并不开心？

lines.en: scene karinjogs20
: What?! O-Of course I had fun! I had a lot of fun! So much fun! It was
lines.zh: : 什么？！我、我当然开心！我开心极了！超级开心！那真是

lines.en: great! It was awesome! It was...It was-"
lines.zh: 太棒了！简直棒极了！那是……那是——”

lines.en: scene karinjogs21
: Oh God! I’m forgetting how words work!
lines.zh: : 哦天哪！我连话都不会说了！

lines.en: : Well, believe it or not, I had fun too. And I’m really looking forward to doing this again.
lines.zh: : 好吧，信不信由你，我也很开心。而且我真的很期待下次再来。

lines.en: : Fun?! You had...but you...the stopwatch...ahhh!
lines.zh: : 开心？！你……可你……那个秒表……啊啊啊！

lines.en: Translation (Projected): Did you really have fun today, Sensei? All you did was stand around with a stopwatch...
lines.zh: 翻译（推测）：老师，你今天真的开心吗？你从头到尾就只是拿着个秒表站在那儿而已……

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Calm down. Catch your breath.
lines.zh: : 好好好。冷静点。先喘口气。

lines.en: : Need me to rub your shoulders?
lines.zh: : 要我给你揉揉肩吗？

lines.en: : Shoulders?!
lines.zh: : 肩膀？！

lines.en: : They’re the things your neck and your arms are connected to.
lines.zh: : 就是连着你脖子和胳膊的那两块。

lines.en: scene karinjogs22
: I know what they are! I’m just suddenly nervous again for some reason!
lines.zh: : 我知道肩膀是什么！我只是不知道为什么又突然紧张起来了！

lines.en: scene black
Karin takes another several minutes to calm herself down and get her eyes to go back to normal.
lines.zh: Karin 又花了几分钟才让自己平静下来，眼神也恢复了正常。

lines.en: "I offer to walk her home (With only the purest of intentions) but she respectfully declines since a
lines.zh: “我提出送她回家（怀着最纯洁的意图），但她礼貌地拒绝了，因为她

lines.en: few of her friends are already waiting for her at her family’s apartment."
lines.zh: 已经有几个朋友在她家的公寓等着她了。”

lines.en: It’s strange.
lines.zh: 真奇怪。

lines.en: Even though all I did was manage a stopwatch this afternoon, I feel suspiciously content.
lines.zh: 尽管今天下午我所做的只是管管秒表，我却有种可疑的满足感。

lines.en: Maybe I just really like when girls get nervous around me?
lines.zh: 也许我就是特别喜欢女孩在我面前紧张的样子？

lines.en: The confidence boost is definitely nice, but-
lines.zh: 这种自信心的提升确实不错，不过——

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我也说不上来。

lines.en: What am I even saying?
lines.zh: 我到底在说些什么？

lines.en: I should just get on with my day...
lines.zh: 我还是继续过我的日子吧……

lines.en: $ karin_love += 1
$ karindate1 = True
{i}Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]!{/i}
